svg.title: PulseTrade architecture diagram
svg.desc: End-to-end architecture showing real-time streaming path via Kafka and Databricks, batch orchestration via Airflow, agentic AI investigation layer, and Kubernetes serving with monitoring.

g.text: Databricks — Spark Structured Streaming + Delta Lake
LangGraph agent + MCP server (Delta tables exposed as tools)
GKE cluster — Helm + GitHub Actions CI/CD

svg.text: Solid arrows = real-time data flow. Airflow reads from Layer 2 and writes to Layers 3 & 4 on schedule.
Each layer color = one logical stage. Gray nodes are external sources.
